faqs.question: What does Donorfit cost an NGO?
faqs.answer: Donorfit is free to use. When a donor pays, the payment provider you connect charges its own transaction fees, which you agree directly with that provider.

faqs.question: Can we run several campaigns at the same time?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each appeal or project can be its own campaign with its own target and progress, and you manage them from one dashboard.

faqs.question: Which solution should we start with?
faqs.answer: It depends on your next initiative: MoneyPool for one project with a shared goal, Water Well for well projects, Sponsorship for long-term support of beneficiaries and Membership if you have members. Our team can help you decide.

faqs.question: Which payment providers can we connect?
faqs.answer: Donorfit integrates with Stripe, PayPal, GoCardless, Mollie and Micropayment. The payment methods your donors see depend on the provider and your account with them.

faqs.question: Can we keep our existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can customise Donorfit donation forms and embed them on the website you already have.

faqs.question: Can we bring in our current donor list?
faqs.answer: Yes. Donorfit includes an import function for existing records, and our team can help you prepare the data.

faqs.question: Is Donorfit really free for charities?
faqs.answer: Yes, Donorfit is free to use. Transaction charges for each payment are set by the payment provider you connect, such as Stripe, PayPal or Mollie.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a donation form and MoneyPool?
faqs.answer: A donation form collects gifts for your charity or a campaign. MoneyPool is built for one project with a goal and a deadline, where a group fundraises together and everyone can follow the progress.

faqs.question: Can we fundraise for medical assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can create a campaign for a medical cause, for example with MoneyPool. Your charity remains responsible for how the funds are used and for any rules that apply to that kind of appeal.

faqs.question: Can donors cover the transaction fee?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can offer donors the option to cover the transaction fee, so your charity receives more of their gift.

faqs.question: Does Donorfit create tax receipts?
faqs.answer: Donorfit includes predefined tax receipt templates for automatic generation. Please check with your tax adviser which details your receipts must contain.

faqs.question: Can we connect our newsletter tool?
faqs.answer: Donorfit integrates with Brevo and Mailchimp. You can also use a custom email provider for system emails.

faqs.question: Can different members pay different rates?
faqs.answer: Yes. Configure as many membership tiers as you need, each with its own pricing, renewal cycle and application fields.

faqs.question: Can we offer lifetime membership?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plans can be annual, monthly or lifetime.

faqs.question: Can members update their own details?
faqs.answer: Yes. Members can update contact details, download membership contribution statements and manage their status in the self-service portal.

faqs.question: Can we see who is eligible to vote at our general assembly?
faqs.answer: Yes. Filter members by status and voting eligibility to produce a current list of active, dues-paid members.

faqs.question: Which payment methods can members use?
faqs.answer: That depends on the payment provider you connect. Donorfit integrates with Stripe, PayPal, GoCardless, Mollie and Micropayment.

faqs.question: Can we raise funds beyond membership dues?
faqs.answer: Yes. MoneyPool works well for one-off projects, and mosque communities can use Qurbani for their seasonal campaign.

faqs.question: Does Donorfit support multiple currencies?
faqs.answer: That depends on the payment provider you connect and your account with them. Please contact our team before launching so we can confirm what is available for your setup.

faqs.question: Can supporters in other countries donate?
faqs.answer: Which donors can pay, and how, is determined by your payment provider. Our team can help you check this for the countries you fundraise in.

faqs.question: Which payment providers are supported?
faqs.answer: Donorfit integrates with Stripe, PayPal, GoCardless, Mollie and Micropayment. Each integration page explains what the provider offers and what you need before connecting it.

faqs.question: Does Donorfit handle regional legal requirements?
faqs.answer: No. Requirements for fundraising, receipts and data protection differ between countries. Please check them with your advisers. Our team can tell you what Donorfit offers.

faqs.question: Who carries out the Qurbani and distributes the meat?
faqs.answer: Your organisation does. Donorfit helps you keep the contributions and donor details organised.

faqs.question: Can donors follow a project after giving?
faqs.answer: Yes. Post updates as the project moves through each stage, so donors can see what their donation achieved.
